description: HAL GPIO mode fixture: PB6/PB7 open-drain 10 Hz in opposite phase; PA1 pull-up, PA2 pull-down, PA3 floating reported every 200 ms on USART1
expect: 72 MHz. PB6/PB7 open-drain (PB6 starts released/Hi-Z, PB7 low), both toggled by ONE BSRR write every 50 ms: 10 Hz square waves (50 ms / 50 ms, +-20 us), PB7 = !PB6 always (needs external pull-ups to read high). PA1 input pull-up, PA2 input pull-down, PA3 floating input. USART1 PA9/PA10 115200 8N1: 'PA1=x PA2=y PA3=z\r\n' (x, y, z = 0/1, one sample per line) right after init, then exactly every 200 ms (+-20 us), each line starting right after a PB6/PB7 toggle. Unconnected: PA1=1 PA2=0, PA3 undefined.

circuit: PB6, PB7: 4.7 kohm pull-up to 3V3 each (released open-drain outputs only read high with one)
PA1, PA2, PA3: unconnected unless a scenario drives them (PA3 then floats)
USART1: virtual terminal on PA9 (TX) / PA10 (RX)
